experiment.operation_boundary: one synchronous direct scientific replay call versus one spa_fgn_graph_process callback; graph construction, fixture copies, feedback carry, parameter publication, PipeWire scheduling, device I/O, and teardown are outside timing
experiment.correctness_oracle: seven pinned frames at five public boundaries plus 1024 delayed-feedback frames; calibrated pixels require bitwise equality and remaining F32 values use combined 1e-6 absolute/scaled-relative tolerance
comparison_limitations: The direct replay materializes a region-major SHWFS pixel slab; the graph uses image views.
The graph exposes all five comparison boundaries and controller feedback; the direct replay stores the same values in one Frame.
These service-time samples do not measure scheduled end-to-end latency or overload behavior.
Frequency and host isolation are observational unless controlled outside this script.
CPU time, context switches, and page faults cover the entire measured child process, including setup and correctness replay, not only timed callbacks.
